title_protection.quote: "Journeyman-in-training" means a person who is licensed under this chapter to assist in making plumbing installations under the direct supervision of a journeyman plumber or a master plumber who may not act as or represent that the person is a journeyman plumber

scope_protection.quote: A license is required for any individual who is engaged in plumbing or performing plumbing installations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any of the reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5-A, paragraph A (the general occupational licensing discipline statute).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny a license, refuse to renew a license or impose the disciplinary sanctions authorized by Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A for any of the reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A, paragraph A.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty or false statement, directly related to plumbing, or for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime which involves dishonesty or false statement or which relates directly to the practice of plumbing, or conviction of any crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed.

definition_quote.value: "Master plumber" means any individual qualified under this chapter engaging in or about to engage in the business of installing plumbing or plumbing systems.
definition_quote.quote: "Master plumber" means any individual qualified under this chapter engaging in or about to engage in the business of installing plumbing or plumbing systems.

methods_authorized.quote: any person who customarily performs the work of installing plumbing and drainage under the employment and direction of a master plumber or, not being a master plumber, does plumbing repair work as a regular part-time occupation

license_tiers.quote: "Journeyman-in-training" means a person who is licensed under this chapter... "Journeyman plumber" means any person who customarily performs the work of installing plumbing... "Limited license" means a limited plumber's license... "Master plumber" means any individual qualified under this chapter... "Trainee plumber" means any person who is engaged in assisting in making plumbing installations

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A trainee plumber must work under the direct supervision of one or more licensed journeyman plumbers or licensed master plumbers.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Trainee plumber" means any person who is engaged in assisting in making plumbing installations under the direct supervision of one or more licensed journeyman plumbers or licensed master plumbers

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: A master or journeyman plumber may not have more than 3 trainee plumbers working under the master or journeyman plumber's direct supervision.

value: minimum 2 years / 4,000 hours as licensed trainee plumber under supervision of master plumber plus passing journeyman's exam
minimum 2,000 hours as journeyman-in-training under licensed master plumber (within 4 years of journeyman-in-training license) plus passing journeyman's exam

completion of one academic year of plumbing instruction at board-approved technical college or community college or career and technical education program or registered DOL apprenticeship program plus passing journeyman's exam (for journeyman-in-training license)
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: A minimum of at least 2 years with 4,000 hours of work in the field of plumbing installations as a licensed trainee plumber under the supervision of a master plumber, or the equivalent thereof, and obtaining a passing grade as determined by the board on the journeyman's examination; or A minimum of 2,000 hours of work in the field of plumbing installations as a journeyman-in-training under the supervision of a licensed master plumber

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: A minimum of at least one year with 2,000 hours of work in the field of plumbing installations as a journeyman plumber or a minimum of at least 4 years with 8,000 hours of work in the field of plumbing installations as a trainee plumber under the supervision of a master plumber, or the equivalent

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Plumbing by a person in a single-family residence occupied or to be occupied by that person as that person's bona fide personal abode as long as the installation conforms with board laws and rules
